method: Live VPC console, read-only. One row selected per list, Actions opened, each item's aria-disabled recorded, menu closed. Nothing invoked.

vpc.disabled_reason: a default VPC already exists in the Region
vpc.correction: The mock shipped 'Edit DNS hostnames' as a top-level item in 1.5.2. It is not one — the console exposes DNS settings inside 'Edit VPC settings'. The mock also lacked Create VPC, Create default VPC, Manage middlebox routes and Create encryption control.

subnet.disabled_reason: the subnet has no IPv6 association; sharing requires Resource Access Manager

route_table.disabled_reason: the selected route table is already the main route table

security_group.note: Two distinct CSV exports — the group list, and the inbound/outbound rules.

network_acl.capture_caveat: Captured with NO row selected, so every item except Create read as disabled. That tells us the item list and that the menu is selection-gated, but not which items are gated on anything further. Recorded as observed rather than cleaned up.

cross_cutting.split_panel_placeholder: Every list carries a split panel whose collapsed label is 'Select a <resource>' and which becomes '<Resource> details' once a row is selected. Observed on subnets, route tables, VPCs, security groups, instances, volumes, snapshots, AMIs, elastic IPs, launch templates and instance types — it is the console's standard list layout, and the mock has it on no page.
cross_cutting.view_details_item: Most VPC-family menus carry a 'View details' item that opens the resource's detail page. The mock has detail pages for some of these now but no menu item that reaches them.
